title: Exclude retained foreign originals from native planning and source lookups
outcome: Exclude retained foreign originals from native planning and source lookups
acceptance: Retaining a foreign WorkSourceProposal and its snapshots does not make local import treat an unseen source revision as already known or suppress its native notice; original retained IDs and bytes remain unchanged.
Native deferred-claim, named-root end and empty-project lookups ignore imported-only objects and preserve their existing native behavior; audit the reported scans for equivalent missing boundaries.

Behavior regressions reproduce reachable foreign-retention effects through the existing evidence retention owner and prove the corrected local behavior; record any reported path that is unreachable with precise evidence instead of adding a needless filter.

completion.summary: Exclude retained foreign originals from native source-known, deferred-claim, named-root end and empty-project lookups. Deliver eight-path scoped repair with four retention-driven regressions and complete remote author evidence.
